practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
practiceReport.beatComment: The Browns are coming out of a bye, so it's unclear whether McGuire picked up the injury during the Browns' Week 10 win over the Texans. Regardless, he'll have two more opportunities to practice in at least a limited capacity ahead of Sunday's game against the Raiders.

practiceReport.name: Denzel Boston
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (90% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
factors: Beat practice observation (beat report): returned to on-field practice ahead of official report
practiceReport.beatComment: Prior to a Week 11 bye, Boston was managing a toe injury and missed Wednesday and Thursday practices Wednesday before being a limited participant Friday. Though he had been listed as questionable ahead of the Browns' Nov. 15 game against the Texans, Boston was ultimately active and recorded an 85 percent snap share in a 27-24 win. It's not clear if Boston is still nursing the same toe injury coming out of that game, or if a different health concern is keeping him off the field to begin Week 12 prep.

practiceReport.name: Harold Fannin Jr.
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (87% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
factors: Wednesday Limited Participation (LP); player toughness prior = 82%
practiceReport.beatComment: The Browns were on bye last week, but it's worth noting that Fannin's reps were also limited Wednesday and Thursday (by the same listed groin issue) ahead of Week 10 action, before the TE logged a full session that Friday and was then cleared to face Houston. With no reported setbacks in his team's 27-24 win over the Texans on Nov. 15, a game in which the TE recorded an 87 percent offensive snap share, it seems likely that Fannin's Wednesday limitations were maintenance-related.

practiceReport.name: Blake Whiteheart
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
factors: Wednesday Limited Participation (LP); player toughness prior = 78%
practiceReport.beatComment: Whiteheart is dealing with a hip issue coming out of the Browns' Week 11 bye, but he'll have two more opportunities to practice in full and avoid an injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Raiders. The 26-year-old tight end has four catches on seven targets for 48 yards and a touchdown through 10 regular-season games.

practiceReport.name: Quincy Williams
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (8th NFL season, 96% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
factors: Wednesday Limited Participation (LP); player toughness prior = 84%
practiceReport.beatComment: Williams may have picked up the injury during the Browns' Week 10 win over the Texans, when he logged nine tackles (five solo) and one pass defense. The injury designation follows the Browns' Week 11 bye, and he'll have two more chances to increase his practice participation ahead of Sunday's game against Las Vegas.

practiceReport.name: Ronnie Hickman
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (99% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
factors: Logged mid-week Full Participation in NFL Concussion Protocol progression
practiceReport.beatComment: Hickman was held out of the Browns' Week 10 win over the Texans while in the league's concussion protocol. Cleveland's Week 11 bye gave him extra time to recover, and while his full session Wednesday is encouraging, Hickman would need to pass an evaluation by an independent neurologist in order to clear protocol and be available to play Sunday against Las Vegas.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Kalia Davis
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Davis injured his quad during training camp in late July and started the regular season on IR. His 21-day window opened Oct. 6, but he has not progressed enough in his recovery to warrant his removal from IR. That means that the 2022 sixth-rounder will be sidelined for the rest of the season unless he reaches an injury settlement with the Browns.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Raheim Sanders
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Sanders was designated to return from injured reserve Tuesday, and he was limited in his first practice session since suffering a hip injury against the Jets in Week 5. He'll have two more opportunities to log a full practice, but Sanders would need to be activated from IR in order to be available for Sunday's game against the Raiders.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Michael Burton
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 11 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Burton was already ruled out for Sunday's game against the Texans due to a calf injury that he picked up against the Saints in Week 9. The injury is severe enough for him to warrant an extended absence, and since he's now on IR, Burton will be required to miss at least four games, so the earliest he can return is Week 15 against the Giants on Sunday, Dec. 20. Since the Browns do not have another fullback on the 53-man roster, the team will likely turn to tight ends Carsen Ryan, Zaire Mitchell-Paden and Blake Whiteheart to provide blocking out of the backfield, per Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Joe Royer
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: 4-game minimum satisfied on Injured Reserve (Personal); awaiting 21-day practice window designation.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Teven Jenkins
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 11 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Jenkins has yet to play in the 2026 regular season due to a persistent back injury. The issue seems to be significant enough that Jenkins will not be able to return to the field soon, leaving the Browns no choice but to place the guard on IR.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Alex Wright
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Wright picked up the injury during Thursday's joint practice with the Bills during a one-on-one drill with offensive tackle Spencer Brown. Follow-up tests revealed the extent of Wright's injury, which will sideline the 2022 third-rounder for the upcoming season. Isaiah McGuire is slated to start at defensive end opposite Jared Verse for the upcoming season, with the Browns adding depth to the position by signing Derek Barnett to a one-year contract.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Damarri Mathis

irAndReserveTracker.name: Edefuan Ulofoshio
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Ulofoshio suffered a biceps injury in Cleveland's final preseason contest Thursday and was waived/injured Sunday. He went unclaimed on waivers and consequently reverted to injured reserve. As a result, Ulofoshio won't be able to play during the 2026 season unless he reaches an injury settlement with the Browns.
